metadata.article_title: Disclosure of particulars by public servants.

article.title: Disclosure of particulars by public servants.
article.content:
280Disclosure of particulars by public servants.

Section 280  ·  Chapter XXII  ·  page 1030 of the Act
(1) If a public servant furnishes any information or produces any document in contravention of the provisions of sub-section (2) of section 138, he
shall be punishable with 39[simple imprisonment up to one month, or with fine, or with both].
(2) No prosecution shall be instituted under this section except with the previous sanction of the Central Government.
39 Sub. for "imprisonment which may extend to six months, and shall also be liable to fine" by Act No. 4 of 2026, w.e.f. 1-3-2026.
